notes: Two chains of ark of covenant: the first (of Jehovah of hosts) has no article morpheme and both the's are supplied under rule 29; the second (of God) carries an article on the rectum which the ASV renders anarthrously, so the article's the is the one standing before covenant, the word its own noun immediately depends on, and the outer construct takes the supplied second the.
above joins the participle's unit as the preposition the English verb needs to reach its object (rules 19 and 44), not the noun's; the supplied relative is the anarthrous participle's under rule 46.
shene bene-Eli: the numeral keeps only two and the supplied determiner joins the noun of the expression (rule 15).

there in were there is read as the fronted adverbial predicate taking the construction-supplied copula (rule 20); the competing reading puts the copula on im under rule 49 and is named in the unit's note.
